purpose: Independent held-out query set for the OFFICIAL relevance comparison of catalog.discover versions. It must never be used to tune lexicon entries, rules or weights.
independence: Queries are NOT written by the author of the interpreter/ranker and are NOT derived from discover-v0-benchmark-v1.
No normalized query may equal a query of discover-v0-benchmark-v1 (checked by heldout.ts).
The file is frozen (sha256 recorded) BEFORE any discover version is run on it; any later edit creates a new set version.
usedForTuning must be false; a version used to change rules or weights is retired as held-out and becomes a development set.

allowed: AUTHORIZED_ANONYMIZED_COMMERCIAL_LOG: real customer/sales queries exported with written authorization, PII removed (names, phones, emails, RUT, addresses, order ids), with a sampling rule declared before export
SALES_TEAM_ELICITATION: queries written by sales staff from real conversations, without seeing discover output
forbidden: queries written by the discover author
queries copied or paraphrased from the development benchmark

queryRecord.queryClass: optional coarse class assigned by the collector, never by the system

adjudication.reviewers: two independent reviewers (R1, R2) blind to system output
adjudication.adjudicator: a third person, distinct from R1 and R2, resolves disagreements
adjudication.relevantProductKeys: graded or binary relevance per productKey; empty until ADJUDICATED

fileShape.catalogObservation: sourceExtractionId the products were adjudicated against

officialComparison: Precision@3, Recall@8, MRR and nDCG@8 (already implemented in evaluation.ts) are computed ONLY over ADJUDICATED queries of a frozen held-out version, for every compared discover version on the same source and bundles.
